entries.title: Close Claude Code agent-config gaps
entries.rationale: Accept as security-gated managed-agent configuration hardening. Preserve isolated config directories, one authoritative model source, local-only persistence boundaries, remote policy environment boundaries, request correlation, and exact Applied/Rejected outcomes; keep BUZZ_* identifiers only where compatibility requires them and adapt visible product text to Zion.
security_reasons: configuration-directory isolation prevents cross-session or cross-agent settings leakage
model and effort policy separation differs for local versus remote execution
local-only persistence must reject remote writes
request correlation and explicit rejection outcomes prevent false success
managed-agent environment and policy values can affect tool authority and secrets

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after managed-agent threat review, environment/secret-leak tests, local-versus-remote policy tests, exact failure-state tests, dependency screening, and Zion branding/compatibility checks.

verification: Full-SHA configuration and launch diff, environment boundaries, policy propagation, request correlation, tests, dependency impact, and compatibility identifiers reviewed; automated security-access report not claimed because its advisory was interrupted; no source implementation made.
